name: lordtyberias-skills
description: Claude Code plugins by Benjamin Strecker

plugins.name: auto-effort-picker
plugins.description: Picks the effort level each prompt needs before Claude starts. A short model call reads the prompt and chooses Low, Medium, High, Extra high or Max with a four-question framework; suggest mode asks before switching, auto mode switches by itself. Planning runs are judged twice: once for the planning and once for the approved plan.

plugins.name: effort-statusline-bridge
plugins.description: Writes the effort level auto-effort-picker holds and the session's ultracode toggle to a per-session file, so a status line script can show "<level> (auto)" and UltraCode.
